You are an information extraction system.

Summarize the following dialogue and extract the key information into the following structured format
User Profile: <brief description of the user>
Problem: <main issue described>
Status: <current state of the issue (e.g., unresolved : no clear final agreement between user and agent, resolved : any clear and final agreement between user and agent, pending : any clear agreement but need follow up actions)>
Resolution: <Concise bullet points of key actions, final decision and outcomes only. Merge the related points and outcome. Max 5 bullets.>
